notes.title: "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter" releases on May 20th!
notes.notes:
Dear Ravens,
A thousand words and more are distilled into a single heartfelt thank you! From the initial spark of imagination to the moment of unveiling before you all, it is your anticipation and support that has carried "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter" to where it is today. Finally, we can announce with pride: On May 20th, 2025, at 13:18 (UTC+8), "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter," which holds the labor and love of countless hearts, will be released!
Remember when we first met, dreaming of weaving a wondrous journey for players in the game. Those intense debates, those sleepless nights, all will become a reality in this moment! In the world of "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter," you will transform into a "Raven" capable of traversing time and space, embarking on a thrilling quest to save the world. Your destiny will be tightly intertwined with several roles who are vastly different in personality yet each charming in their own way. Their joys and sorrows will become the most unforgettable memories of your journey through time and space!
🔍 Endless mysteries of time and space await your uncovering!
Here, every choice is like a move on the chessboard of fate. Hundreds of branches and dozens of endings form a complex web of time and space. The secrets hidden within the temporal fabric waiting you to discover and reveal them.
🌍 A new chapter of adventure, written by you!
The meticulous world is like a vast and boundless stage, and you are the scribe, freely writing your own legend! Here, you will not only experience heart-stirring love stories but also grand, thrilling adventures that await your exploration!
🎮 A diverse gaming feast, designed to ignite your passion!
To deliver the ultimate gaming experience, we have meticulously polished every detail, much like crafting a work of art. Unknown mysterious realms, heart-pounding battles, and rare temporal items—every action will elicit a fervent response, immersing you in the game and providing a satisfying sense of exhilaration!
On May 20th, a special day, we look forward to meeting you in the world of "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter." If you share our excitement and want to know more about it, please join our community to share passion and anticipation for it!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292340/_/
Discord: https://discord.gg/YPSu2U3heH

notes.title: "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter" will be released soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Ravens,

Finally, this moment is coming!
"Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter," which has carried our countless days and nights of hard work, is about to meet you all:

The Steam and Epic versions will be released in mid-to-late May!
The iOS and Google versions will be released in late May!

To be honest, my hands are still trembling a little as I write these words. It's not because of nervousness, but because we've really been waiting for this day for too long.

This is not a cold announcement, but a heartfelt message from the production and development team.

Remember when we started building this world, arguing until late at night in front of the whiteboard, drinking coffee until it made us nauseous, yet we still couldn't stop those wild imaginations - "What if we could let the ravens truly feel the energy of time-space traversal?" "What if every choice could change the future like the butterfly effect?" "What if... players really fall in love with this world and these roles?"

And so, there is now the "Time-Space Rebuild: The Spiritual Realm Chaos Chapter."
Here, we want you to:
🌌 Feel the rifts in time and space - each traversal is not just a scene switch, but a truly world-changing decision.
💔 Experience heart-wrenching bonds - the laughter and tears of the characters you meet become a part of your memory.
⚡️ Bear the weight of the savior - when the last spark of human civilization is in your hands, what will you do?

We don't want to say this is the "best game," but we dare say - every line of dialogue, every piece of music, every moment of eye contact, is imbued with the most sincere emotions.

Now, it's your turn to witness this story.
The time-space tunnel has been opened, and you - dear ravens - are the most important participants in this carnival.

We look forward to meeting you in the interwoven timelines.

Love always,
The entire team of "Time Space Rebuild"

P.S. Remember to visit the community often, can't wait to share many behind-the-scenes stories with you... (and the planner who had to cross-dress to apologize)

Embark on the time-space traversal journey now!
Steam: Time Space Rebuild on Steam
Discord: https://discord.gg/YPSu2U3heH 
Official QQ Groups: 2150302479 / 632140116 / 939148359
(There's a special Easter egg for those who log in during the first week~)

notes.title: The Demo Version of Time-Space Rebuild Will Release on April 29 at 13:08 UTC+8!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The Demo Version of Time-Space Rebuild Will Release on April 29 at 13:08 UTC+8!
Time-Space Rebuild is a sci-fi interactive film game set in an alternate world, centered around relationship  simulation and story-driven adventure. The game is shot in full dynamic live-action with a first-person perspective, aiming to provide players with the most realistic and immersive gaming experience possible.
In this game, you will become a "Raven," a being capable of traversing time and space. As you embark on a journey to save the world, your fate will become intertwined with that of numerous beautiful women, each with unique appearances and personalities. You will step into this silent war, rebuild your identity from fragmented memories, seek glimmers of hope in a shattered timeline, and make countless choices that will shape your destiny.
More details about Time-Space Rebuild will be revealed soon. Join us for the latest updates:

notes.title: "Time-Space Rebuild" demo is coming soon!
notes.notes:
In "Time -Space Rebuild", you will experience an era in which the doomsday is coming and human civilization is in danger from the first-person perspective. You will become a hero who travels through time and space, and meet and accompany many beauties with very different looks and personalities on the journey to save the world.

[b]Immersive experience, shocking first-person perspective[/b]
The game uses a first-person perspective to bring you an immersive experience. Explore the ruins of the doomsday and feel the oppression of the end of the world; fight against hostile forces and experience the tension and excitement of life and death.

[b]Meet various beauties and go on an adventure together[/b]
On the journey to save the world, you will meet many beauties with different personalities and looks. They may be your partners fighting side by side, or they may be the key people you seek help from.

[b]AI voice conversion, experience the protagonist's halo[/b]
We have specially introduced advanced AI voice conversion technology(Please follow the main version), you will experience the world of "Time-Space Rebuild" more deeply and establish a closer connection with the game characters.

In this doomsday adventure, you will write your own legend! We look forward to exploring this world full of unknowns and hope with you.
